dialogues.jp: 「誰もおらん」
dialogues.en: "No one's here."
dialogues.text: "No one's here."

dialogues.jp:
神社では、環どころか、参拝客もまともにいな
かった。
dialogues.en: The shrine, Tamaki's place, was devoid of worshippers today.
dialogues.text: The shrine, Tamaki's place, was devoid of worshippers today.

dialogues.jp:
この神社が｛にぎ／賑｝わうのは、正月と縁日の日くらい
らしい。
dialogues.en:
The main days of bustle for this shrine seems to be the new
year, and during festivals.
dialogues.text:
The main days of bustle for this shrine seems to be the new
year, and during festivals.

dialogues.jp: 商店街をふらつきながら、今日の予定を考える。
dialogues.en:
Standing in the middle of the shopping district, I laid out
my plans for today.
dialogues.text:
Standing in the middle of the shopping district, I laid out
my plans for today.

dialogues.jp:
いつものことだけど、ゲーセンに行くか、ぶら
ぶらとウインドーショッピングするか、本屋で
立ち読みするぐらいしか思いつかない。
dialogues.en:
I didn't feel like going to the arcades, or window shopping,
or reading books at the bookstore, or doing anything normal.
dialogues.text:
I didn't feel like going to the arcades, or window shopping,
or reading books at the bookstore, or doing anything normal.

dialogues.jp:
「ここはひとつ、新しい暇の潰し方を考えて時
　間潰すか」
dialogues.en:
"At times like these, you start to find different things to
waste time on."
dialogues.text:
"At times like these, you start to find different things to
waste time on."

dialogues.jp:
「……って、何かそれはそれでかったるそうだ
　よなぁ」
dialogues.en: "...Bleh, what am I saying."
dialogues.text: "...Bleh, what am I saying."

dialogues.jp: なんてことを考えていると。
dialogues.en: Didn't really know what I was thinking either.
dialogues.text: Didn't really know what I was thinking either.

dialogues.jp: 人混みの中、見知った顔を見つけた。
dialogues.en: Within the crowd of passers-by, I saw a familiar face.
dialogues.text: Within the crowd of passers-by, I saw a familiar face.

dialogues.jp: 「よお」
dialogues.en: "Yo."
dialogues.text: "Yo."

dialogues.jp: 荷物をたくさん抱えた環だった。
dialogues.en: It was Tamaki, carrying a lot of bags with her.
dialogues.text: It was Tamaki, carrying a lot of bags with her.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「あら、朝倉様。こんにちは」
dialogues.en: "My, Asakura-sama. Good afternoon."
dialogues.text: "My, Asakura-sama. Good afternoon."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「こんなところにいたんだな。何してるんだ？」
dialogues.en: "Odd to meet you here. What's up?"
dialogues.text: "Odd to meet you here. What's up?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「ええ、ちょっと買い物に……」
dialogues.en: "Ahh, I was doing a little shopping..."
dialogues.text: "Ahh, I was doing a little shopping..."

dialogues.jp:
なるほど。確かに環が持っている袋からは、ち
りとりや鍋、やかんなど、日用品がたくさん顔
を覗かせていた。
dialogues.en:
I see. As she said, she was carrying things like dustpans,
pots, kettles, and other daily neccessities.
dialogues.text:
I see. As she said, she was carrying things like dustpans,
pots, kettles, and other daily neccessities.

dialogues.jp:
（けど……女の子が一人で持つには量があるよ
　な）
dialogues.en: "(But... sending a girl, alone, to carry all this stuff?)"
dialogues.text: "(But... sending a girl, alone, to carry all this stuff?)"

dialogues.jp: 俺がそう思っていると。
dialogues.en: My thoughts were quickly interrupted.
dialogues.text: My thoughts were quickly interrupted.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉様、あの……今時間ありますか？」
dialogues.en: "Asakura-sama, um... are you free right now?"
dialogues.text: "Asakura-sama, um... are you free right now?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「ん？　どうした？」
dialogues.en: "Mm? Anything I can do for you?"
dialogues.text: "Mm? Anything I can do for you?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「実は、｛たけぼうき／竹箒｝を探していて……」
dialogues.en: "I've been searching for bamboo brooms for sale..."
dialogues.text: "I've been searching for bamboo brooms for sale..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「竹箒？」
dialogues.en: "Bamboo brooms?"
dialogues.text: "Bamboo brooms?"

dialogues.jp:
……って言うとあれだよな。魔法使いが乗って
いる奴だよな？
dialogues.en: ...You mean the type that witches ride on?
dialogues.text: ...You mean the type that witches ride on?

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「はい。今境内を掃いているのが壊れてしまっ
　て……新しいのを買おうと思って」
dialogues.en:
"Yes. The one I normally use for cleaning the shrine
compound recently broke... I thought I would buy a new one
today."
dialogues.text:
"Yes. The one I normally use for cleaning the shrine
compound recently broke... I thought I would buy a new one
today."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「でも、島に来たばかりで、どこに売っている
　のかわからないんです」
dialogues.en:
"But, I've only moved here recently, and I don't know where
to find it..."
dialogues.text:
"But, I've only moved here recently, and I don't know where
to find it..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「なるほど……。ホウキの売ってる場所か」
dialogues.en: "I see... a store that sells brooms."
dialogues.text: "I see... a store that sells brooms."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「……朝倉様のお時間があればでいいんですけ
　ど……」
dialogues.en: "If you are not free, that's fine too..."
dialogues.text: "If you are not free, that's fine too..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「時間なんか、いくらでもある」
dialogues.en: "I am, let's go."
dialogues.text: "I am, let's go."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「本当ですか？」
dialogues.en: "You are?"
dialogues.text: "You are?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「ちょうどヒマをもてあましてたところなんだ。
　環と過ごせるなんて、願ったり叶ったりだ」
dialogues.en:
"I was bored out of my mind anyway. My wish to spend time
with you ended up coming true."
dialogues.text:
"I was bored out of my mind anyway. My wish to spend time
with you ended up coming true."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「えっ？」
dialogues.en: "Ehhh?"
dialogues.text: "Ehhh?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.en: "Hm?"
dialogues.text: "Hm?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「今……なんて？」
dialogues.en: "What... did you say?"
dialogues.text: "What... did you say?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「ああ、ヒマをもてあましてたって」
dialogues.en: "Ahh, I said I was bored out of my mind."
dialogues.text: "Ahh, I said I was bored out of my mind."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「違います、その後です！」
dialogues.en: "No, I mean after that!"
dialogues.text: "No, I mean after that!"

dialogues.jp: いつになく強い口調で環が言う。
dialogues.en: Her tone was unusually strong.
dialogues.text: Her tone was unusually strong.

dialogues.jp:
「その後って……えーっと、環と過ごせるなん
　て願ったり叶ったり……」
dialogues.en:
"After that... erm... that my wish to spend time with you
ended up coming true..."
dialogues.text:
"After that... erm... that my wish to spend time with you
ended up coming true..."

dialogues.jp:
環の頬が赤く染まって……俺も自分の言葉が含
む意味に気づいた。
dialogues.en:
Tamaki's cheeks started glowing red... which was when I
realized what my words could imply.
dialogues.text:
Tamaki's cheeks started glowing red... which was when I
realized what my words could imply.

dialogues.jp:
「や、べ、別に深い意味なんてないぞ！　ただ、
　その……俺は、ヒマだったから……」
dialogues.en:
"N, no, I didn't mean it like that! J, just that, since I
was bored..."
dialogues.text:
"N, no, I didn't mean it like that! J, just that, since I
was bored..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「そ、そうなんですか……？」
dialogues.en: "I, is that so...?"
dialogues.text: "I, is that so...?"

dialogues.jp: 心なしか落ち込んだように見える環。
dialogues.en: Now she looked depressed instead.
dialogues.text: Now she looked depressed instead.

dialogues.jp:
「あ、いや……別に誰でもいいって訳じゃなく
　てだな、その……」
dialogues.en:
"Ah, uh... that doesn't mean just anyone would've done... I
mean..."
dialogues.text:
"Ah, uh... that doesn't mean just anyone would've done... I
mean..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「よく……わからないです」
dialogues.en: "I... don't quite understand."
dialogues.text: "I... don't quite understand."

dialogues.jp:
環は、赤い顔を隠すように俯いて、そう言った。
買い物袋を抱えたままモジモジする環。
dialogues.en:
Bowing her head slightly to hide her red face, her fingers
started to fidget with her bags.
dialogues.text:
Bowing her head slightly to hide her red face, her fingers
started to fidget with her bags.

dialogues.jp: 「……まあ、細かいことは気にすんな」
dialogues.en: "...Well, don't worry yourself over the details."
dialogues.text: "...Well, don't worry yourself over the details."

dialogues.jp: 俺は、結局ハハハと笑い飛ばした。
dialogues.en: I laughed heartily, trying to lighten the mood.
dialogues.text: I laughed heartily, trying to lighten the mood.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「そうですね」
dialogues.en: "I suppose you're right."
dialogues.text: "I suppose you're right."

dialogues.jp: 環も苦笑しながら、その場を濁した。
dialogues.en:
A little smile grew on her lips as well, albeit one with a
tad of uncertainty.
dialogues.text:
A little smile grew on her lips as well, albeit one with a
tad of uncertainty.

dialogues.jp: 「さ、早く行かないと、遅くなるぜ？」
dialogues.en: "Let's head off, we've spent long enough here."
dialogues.text: "Let's head off, we've spent long enough here."

dialogues.jp: 環は、歩き始めた俺の後ろにつく。
dialogues.en: Tamaki started following behind me.
dialogues.text: Tamaki started following behind me.

dialogues.jp:
そして、しばらくは会話もないまま、トコトコ
と歩く俺と環。
dialogues.en: And, without any talking between us, we continued walking.
dialogues.text: And, without any talking between us, we continued walking.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「あの……朝倉様」
dialogues.en: "Um... Asakura-sama?"
dialogues.text: "Um... Asakura-sama?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.en: "Yeah?"
dialogues.text: "Yeah?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「ありがとうございます」
dialogues.en: "Thank you."
dialogues.text: "Thank you."

dialogues.jp:
ひょっこりと顔を出し、隣に並んだ環がそう
言った。
dialogues.en: She'd walked up to my side, and bowed to me.
dialogues.text: She'd walked up to my side, and bowed to me.

dialogues.jp: 「何がだよ？」
dialogues.en: "Eh, why?"
dialogues.text: "Eh, why?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「わたくしの買い物に付き合ってくださってで
　す」
dialogues.en: "For accompanying me to do my shopping..."
dialogues.text: "For accompanying me to do my shopping..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「……だから言ったろ。腐るほど時間があるか
　ら付き合うだけで……そんなの、いちいち礼
　を言われるもんじゃない」
dialogues.en:
"...Like I said, this is much better than letting that time
go to waste... you don't have to thank me for something like
that."
dialogues.text:
"...Like I said, this is much better than letting that time
go to waste... you don't have to thank me for something like
that."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「そうでしょうか？」
dialogues.en: "Is that so?"
dialogues.text: "Is that so?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「何もしてないのに、お礼を言われても、逆に
　こっちが気を遣うだけだ」
dialogues.en:
"Rather than you thanking me, I should be the one thanking
you."
dialogues.text:
"Rather than you thanking me, I should be the one thanking
you."

dialogues.jp: 環が、うーんと首を傾げる。
dialogues.en:
Tamaki still seemed unsure though, tilting her head in
thought.
dialogues.text:
Tamaki still seemed unsure though, tilting her head in
thought.

dialogues.jp:
荷物が重いせいか、気を抜くと歩くペースがと
たんに遅くなる。
dialogues.en:
Thanks to her bags too, her walking pace was far slower than
mine.
dialogues.text:
Thanks to her bags too, her walking pace was far slower than
mine.

dialogues.jp: 「……やれやれ」

慌てて体勢を立て直す環の手から、俺は荷物を
取り上げる。
dialogues.en:
I took the bags from her without saying anything, and she
let me.
dialogues.text:
I took the bags from her without saying anything, and she
let me.

dialogues.jp: 「……ほら、行こうぜ」
dialogues.en: "...Let's go."
dialogues.text: "...Let's go."

dialogues.jp:
ずっしりと重い荷物に呆れながら、再び歩き出
す。この上にホウキまで買う予定だったのか？
dialogues.en:
The sheer weight of the bags surprised me. She wanted to buy
brooms on top of this?
dialogues.text:
The sheer weight of the bags surprised me. She wanted to buy
brooms on top of this?

dialogues.jp: 「無理すんなっての」
dialogues.en: "You shouldn't overdo it."
dialogues.text: "You shouldn't overdo it."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「……すみません」
dialogues.en: "...I'm sorry."
dialogues.text: "...I'm sorry."

dialogues.jp: 何となく表情を暗くする環。
dialogues.en: Her demeanour became a little gloomy.
dialogues.text: Her demeanour became a little gloomy.

dialogues.jp: 「だから、こういう時に、だな」
dialogues.en: "You see, at times like this, then it's appropriate."
dialogues.text: "You see, at times like this, then it's appropriate."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.en: "Ehhh?"
dialogues.text: "Ehhh?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「ありがとう、だ」
dialogues.en: "The words "thank you", I mean."
dialogues.text: "The words "thank you", I mean."

dialogues.jp:
さっきの会話を思い出したのだろう。慌てて礼
を言おうとする環だったが、俺はそれを先回り
して。
dialogues.en:
She then remembered our conversation earlier. I quickly
forestalled her attempts to thank me.
dialogues.text:
She then remembered our conversation earlier. I quickly
forestalled her attempts to thank me.

dialogues.jp:
「……別に礼はいらないぞ。環が重そうにして
　歩いてるのを、俺が見てるのがかったるいか
　ら持ってるだけだからな」
dialogues.en:
"...No need to thank me. It was just troublesome how slow
you were walking, carrying all that heavy stuff..."
dialogues.text:
"...No need to thank me. It was just troublesome how slow
you were walking, carrying all that heavy stuff..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「それって……」
dialogues.en: "Well, then..."
dialogues.text: "Well, then..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「なんだよ？」
dialogues.en: "What now?"
dialogues.text: "What now?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉様って、優しいですよね」
dialogues.en: "You're a really nice person."
dialogues.text: "You're a really nice person."

dialogues.jp: 環がにっこりと微笑んで言った。
dialogues.en:
Tamaki smiled brilliantly at me, as she finished her
sentence.
dialogues.text:
Tamaki smiled brilliantly at me, as she finished her
sentence.

dialogues.jp:
一瞬、環が何を言ってるかわからなくて、間抜
けな声を出してしまった。
dialogues.en:
I answered like an idiot, not understanding what she meant
at first.
dialogues.text:
I answered like an idiot, not understanding what she meant
at first.

dialogues.jp: 「待て待て。俺は別に優しくないぞ？」
dialogues.en: "Hold on now. I'm hardly particularly nice!"
dialogues.text: "Hold on now. I'm hardly particularly nice!"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「そんなことありません。口では変なこと言っ
　ても、肝心なところで助けてくれますもの」
dialogues.en:
"That's not true. Your mouth may say otherwise, but your
actions are always that of helping others."
dialogues.text:
"That's not true. Your mouth may say otherwise, but your
actions are always that of helping others."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「……かったるいだけなんだがな」
dialogues.en: "...This is so troublesome."
dialogues.text: "...This is so troublesome."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「朝倉様は優しい方です。他の誰が違うと言っ
　ても、わたくしはそう思います……！」
dialogues.en:
"You are a very nice person. No matter what anyone might
say, I will always think that...!"
dialogues.text:
"You are a very nice person. No matter what anyone might
say, I will always think that...!"

dialogues.jp:
環は胸の前で腕を組むと、微笑みながら、力強
くそう言った。
dialogues.en:
Tamaki foldered her arms over her chest, smiling and
speaking with a surprising amount of passion.
dialogues.text:
Tamaki foldered her arms over her chest, smiling and
speaking with a surprising amount of passion.

dialogues.jp: 「そ、そうか……」
dialogues.en: "I, I see..."
dialogues.text: "I, I see..."

dialogues.jp:
そこまで断言されると、他に言葉を見つけられ
なくて。
dialogues.en: I couldn't find any words to counter such a declaration.
dialogues.text: I couldn't find any words to counter such a declaration.

dialogues.jp:
俺は妙に顔が｛ほて／火照｝るのを｛ごまか／誤魔化｝すように、日用
品が売っている、ディスカウントセンターへと
急いだ。
dialogues.en:
Trying to ignore the heat from my cheeks, I led us to the
discount center.
dialogues.text:
Trying to ignore the heat from my cheeks, I led us to the
discount center.

dialogues.jp: ◆環の買い物◆
dialogues.en: ◆amaki's Shopping?◆
dialogues.text: ◆amaki's Shopping?◆

dialogues.jp:
神社に行っても誰もいなかったため、商店街を
ふらついていると、買い物する環に出会う。
dialogues.en:
Seeing no one at the shrine, I headed out for the shopping
district, and met Tamaki.
dialogues.text:
Seeing no one at the shrine, I headed out for the shopping
district, and met Tamaki.

dialogues.jp:
聞けば、｛たけぼうき／竹箒｝の売っている場所が分からないと
言う。
dialogues.en:
According to her, she hadn't any idea where to buy bamboo
brooms.
dialogues.text:
According to her, she hadn't any idea where to buy bamboo
brooms.

dialogues.jp:
あまりに重そうに荷物を持っているので、代わ
りに持ってやると、環が俺のことを優しいと言
うのだった。
dialogues.en:
Seeing that she was carrying such heavy bags, I carried them
in her place, and she remarked that I was a nice person.
dialogues.text:
Seeing that she was carrying such heavy bags, I carried them
in her place, and she remarked that I was a nice person.

dialogues.jp:
俺は、環がひーひー言ってるのがかったるいか
ら持ってやっただけなんだがな。
dialogues.en: All I could do was sigh at how troublesome it all was.
dialogues.text: All I could do was sigh at how troublesome it all was.
